messages:
maya-partnerships: Quick flag: we're seeing intermittent OOMs on MI300 in eu-west when running long-context evals (rebel-13b @ v3, seq 8k). Looks like a KV-cache expansion pattern, not model param overflow. Need short cross-org mitigation so customer demos don't get impacted.

dex-eng: Thanks. Minimal repro and node?

maya-partnerships: Repro: rebel-13b@v3, seq_len=8192, batch=1, node mi300-eu-05. Log: "GPU OOM during KV-append" after ~30m.

sam-platform: Proposal: push a temporary routing policy `longseq-fallback-eu` (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%) to route that model_id in EU to H100/H200 SKU pool. Also prepare a non-blocking marketplace editorial that surfaces those fallback SKUs.

aya-cloud: I can author the marketplace update. Suggest mapping: rebel-13b -> eu: [H100-XL, H200-STD]. Will hold publish until SI window confirmed.

mi300-vendor: We can reproduce and are working a patch. ETA RC binary 48-72h. Short-term suggestion: set `gpu_mem_guard=0.88` and reduce max_batch to 2 for affected nodes. We'll provide RC notes for SI runs.

gaudi-vendor: We'll run parity long-seq stress on Gaudi if you share the exact commit/tag. No regression seen so far on our infra.

dex-eng: Also adding a soft runtime rule: if seq_len > 4096 prefer H100 kernel path for rebel-13b model id (config toggle). Need a perf/cost delta table vs H100 for comms.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-812 created: "MI300 eu-west longseq KV growth - OOM". Runbook stub: internal link.

maya-partnerships: Action owners: @sam-platform routing + canary, @aya-cloud marketplace draft, @dex-eng runtime toggle + perf delta, @mi300-vendor RC + test notes, @gaudi-vendor parity test. Reconvene in 36-48h or when RC available. :thumbsup:
